Inspection Question: Is a current vibration and pipe-support review on file for compressor discharge piping?

Inspection Question: Are relief-device test and certification dates in date?
Expected Safety Condition: Each device has a certificate within its interval, issued by a competent person.

Inspection Question: Is the compressor area free of oil leaks and drips near hot surfaces?

Inspection Question: Is a consolidated inspection register available for storage vessels, cylinders and piping?
Expected Safety Condition: One register showing last and next inspection by a competent person for each item.
Recommended Corrective Action: Consolidate registers; schedule overdue inspections.

Inspection Question: Is impact protection (bollards or barriers) intact around storage and piping?

Inspection Question: Is the storage area secured against unauthorised access?
Expected Safety Condition: Gate and fence intact, lock working, warning signs legible, visitor log used.

Inspection Question: Is the emergency isolation location known, accessible and unobstructed?
Expected Safety Condition: Emergency shutdown buttons and isolation points are visible, labelled and clear.
Recommended Corrective Action: Clear obstructions; label; escalate if remote isolation is not available.

Inspection Question: Are ignition sources controlled in and around hazardous areas?
Expected Safety Condition: Hazardous-area boundaries marked; no smoking, phones or unapproved equipment inside.

Inspection Question: Is electrical equipment in hazardous areas covered by a current competent-person inspection record?
Expected Safety Condition: Inspection record in date; no unapproved modifications noted.
Recommended Corrective Action: Arrange a competent-person electrical inspection.

Inspection Question: Is each transfer hose within its service life and free of visible damage?
Expected Safety Condition: Hose tag in date; no cuts, abrasion, kinks or damaged end fittings.
Recommended Corrective Action: Remove damaged hoses from service; replace.

Inspection Question: Is the transfer checklist completed with a second-person read-back for the coupling?
Expected Safety Condition: Checklist signed by two people before pressurisation.
Recommended Corrective Action: Retrain on the checklist; audit sheets weekly.

Inspection Question: Is trailer earthing and restraint confirmed before transfer starts?
Expected Safety Condition: Earthing connected and chocks in place, recorded on the checklist.
Recommended Corrective Action: Hold the transfer until confirmed; review the checklist.

Inspection Question: Is the exclusion zone marked, barriered and clear of unauthorised people and vehicles?
Expected Safety Condition: Markings visible, barriers in place, only authorised people inside.

Inspection Question: Is a working communication method confirmed at the start of each shift?

Inspection Question: Is a supervisor present or reachable for each transfer, as defined by the procedure?
Expected Safety Condition: Named supervisor recorded on the transfer record.
Recommended Corrective Action: Revise rostering; reinforce the supervision rule.

Inspection Question: Is the tube trailer's periodic inspection certificate in date?
Expected Safety Condition: Certificate issued by a competent person is in date and held with the trailer record.
Recommended Corrective Action: Take the trailer out of service until the certificate is renewed.

Inspection Question: Was the pre-trip checklist completed in full, including brakes, lights, tyres and valve guards?
Expected Safety Condition: All checklist items completed and signed by the driver.
Recommended Corrective Action: Reject the trip until complete; coach the driver.

Inspection Question: Are valve protection, relief outlets and pipework free of visible damage or leakage signs?
Expected Safety Condition: No visible damage, corrosion or leak indication; guards in place.
Recommended Corrective Action: Do not move the trailer; refer to a competent person.

Inspection Question: Are trailer access steps and walkways free of damage and slip hazards?

Inspection Question: Is the planned route recorded, with known risk points and rest stops?

Inspection Question: Is each driver within the planned driving-hour and rest limits?
Expected Safety Condition: Driver hours recorded and inside company limits.

Inspection Question: Is the customer site assessed and recorded as suitable before the first delivery?

Inspection Question: Are two trained people assigned to each customer connection?

Inspection Question: Do drivers carry emergency information cards and the dispatch emergency number?

Inspection Question: Has driver training on trailer stability and rollover risk been recorded?

Inspection Question: For hot work, is a gas test recorded before the work starts?
Expected Safety Condition: Gas test result and time recorded on the permit by the issuer.
